uos: 1.b. Appreciate the style of drawing, rendering and body proportion adopted by prominent fashion illustrator.

units.title: Style and techniques of Fashion illustrators
topics: 2.1. Select any well-known illustrator’s work and copy it with the same mediums and techniques used by the illustrator.

units.title: Rendering of materials

Render unidirectional light; for example: satin, silk, denim, leather, corduroy, translucent cotton (mulmul), chiffon and georgette. (Use appropriate medium and technique suitable to the quality of the fabric.)
uos: 4.a. Procure garments made out of specific materials.
4.b. Render different fabrics on dress form.
